paragraphs.text: "Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch." —Naimah, Femeref philosopher
"It is vain to look for a defense against lightning." —Publius Syrus, Maxim 835, trans. Lyman
"A wisp of life remains in the undergloom of Death: a visible form, though no heart beats within it." —Homer, *The Iliad*, trans. Fitzgerald
"If a man will begin with certainties, he shall end in doubts." —Sir Francis Bacon, *The Advancement of Learning*
